Down a dark alley.
Aug 2026 • Couples
Location, is a bit odd, it's like walking upstairs in someones house, passed their shoes, outside their apartment doors on the stairs, down a dark alley way. Was a little scary. The bar is very dark, there are no main lights, found it hard to read the menu. Cocktails read amazing, but sorry to say, do not taste so good.
Value
Service
Atmosphere
Written September 8, 2026
Leo's Tavern
Thank you for sharing your review with us. We're truly sorry that the cocktails didn't quite suit your taste. We always aim to make our drinks as enjoyable as possible, and we understand that not every drink will be to everyone's preference. We'll take your review seriously and keep working to improve.

Regarding the location and atmosphere, Leo’s Tavern is tucked away in Hanoi’s bustling Old Quarter, surrounded by narrow alleys and closely packed residential houses, with hidden entrance and dim lighting as part of our concept, although we understand that the low lighting can make reading the menu somewhat difficult.

We’re sorry that the overall experience wasn’t quite what you expected, and we hope you’ll give us another chance in the future. We’d love to make your next visit a better one.

From Leo's Tavern Team.

Fantastic cocktails, great atmosphere, wonderful staff
May 2026 • Friends
What a wonderful place to find in Hanoi. The staff are lovely, the atmosphere is friendly and welcoming and the cocktails are out of this world. Definitely the best and most interesting cocktails I’ve ever had anywhere. This was my first visit to Hanoi but I am planning to come back next year so I will be visiting Leo’s Tavern frequently so I can try as many of the cocktails as possible. One of the highlights of my trip.

A special mention to Duy, the cocktail barman, who clearly takes real pride in creating his own cocktails and doing things with personality rather than simply following a menu. He was welcoming, creative, engaging, and made the whole experience memorable.

If you enjoy bars with character rather than generic tourist venues, this place is absolutely worth visiting.
